content: Dread Ambusher Feature You have mastered the art of creating fearsome ambushes, granting you the following benefits.Ambusher’s Leap. content: Channel Divinity Channel Divinity You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes, using it to fuel magical effects. You start with one such effect: Divine Sense, which is described below. Other Paladin features give additional Channel Divinity effect options. Each time you use this class’s Channel Divinity, you choose which effect from this class to create.You can use this class’s Channel Divinity twice. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain an additional use when you reach Paladin level 11.If a Channel Divinity effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals the spell save DC from this class’s Spellcasting feature.Divine Sense. As a Bonus Action, you can open your awareness to detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead. For the next 10 minutes or until you have the Incapacitated condition, you know the location of any creature of those types within 60 feet of yourself, and you know its creature type. Within the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place or object that has been consecrated or desecrated, as with the Hallow spell. Consume Resource Refund Resource Bonus Action Instantaneous 60 ft Self

author: DVSDeA29YhlyJV2g
content: Ember-Touched Greatsword Martial Melee • Graze Weapon (Greatsword), CommonA staple of the Flaming Fist of Baldur's Gate — duty-blades quenched, their smiths swear, in the company's own forge-fire, so the steel keeps a banked heat that never quite goes out. The pawnbroker on Daggerford's market square sold it cheap; he was tired, he said, of his shop window smoldering like a hearth after dark.In Darkness, the unsheathed blade of this weapon glows like charcoal embers, creating Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.The banked heat sears where the blade bites: when you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 1 Fire damage. author: iMPHMzzzg1qCN7dy
content: First Light Martial Melee • Sap A dawnbringer's blade, consecrated in a temple of Lathander at the hour of first light — its fuller inlaid with rose-gold that catches the faintest dawn.In a righteous hand its edge kindles with the pale fire of morning, cutting not with steel but with light. A paladin of the Morninglord carried it east down the Trade Way and never came back, and a hobgoblin captain took it as a trophy, blind to the warmth still sleeping in the steel.Once between dawns its bearer may call on the Morninglord's grace, and the blade's light pours into a single companion — a dawnfire courage that no fear can touch, steeling heart and body anew with every breath it burns. Attack Damage Action Instantaneous reach 5 ft Attuned Equipped Proficient

author: iMPHMzzzg1qCN7dy
content: Lay on Hands Feature Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of Hit Points equal to five times your Paladin level.As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and draw power from the pool of healing to restore a number of Hit Points to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool.You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don’t also restore Hit Points to the creature. Healing Consume Resource Refund Resource Bonus Action Instantaneous Self 1 creature
